choices.reasoning: Strong synergistic hand: Hawkeye counters Ultron Drones (4 arrow counters kill 1-HP drones as they spawn), Energy Absorption (3 energy) perfectly funds Hawkeye or enables Photonic Blast's bonus draw, Maria Hill cycles herself, and Triskelion/Get Ready serve as flexible fuel. Keeping the whole hand for a deterministic, explosive turn 1.
Commander is free and draws a card before I plan payments; the extra card may provide resources or a better play, and the action is once per round so use it now.

Play Hawkeye first — he is the key anti-Drone engine versus Ultron (4 arrow counters kill 1-HP drones as they spawn). Paying with Energy Absorption (exactly 3 energy) cleanly funds his cost without wasting any other cards.
Energy Absorption alone provides exactly the 3 energy needed — a perfect, waste-free payment that preserves every other card in hand for Maria Hill's cost and the Photonic Blast nuke.
Play Maria Hill next: cost 2, and her response draws a card so she partly replaces herself. She gives me a 2-THW body for threat control and can finish off the setup Drone this turn.
Fuel with The Triskelion and Make the Call — the two least valuable cards in hand to keep. This preserves Photonic Blast (the 5-damage nuke) and Get Ready (0-cost utility) for later turns.
Free card draw from Maria Hill's enter-play response — strictly beneficial.

Kill the setup Drone with Hawkeye before the villain phase: it stops 1 damage/attack or 1 threat per round, and keeps drones off the board so Ultron stage 2's +1 ATK per Drone never builds up. Hawkeye's response pings don't need him ready, so exhausting him is free.
Maria attacks Ultron for 1 damage — she's better used chipping the villain now since threat is at zero and I'll need her fresh THW 2 later when threat actually accumulates.

Flip to hero so Ultron attacks instead of scheming in the villain phase (threat stays at 1/round), which lets Hawkeye's response answer the Drone Ultron spawns — and enables my basic attack this turn.

Basic attack for 2 damage on Ultron — no one can defend tonight anyway (both allies and hero will be exhausted), so I'm converting this turn into maximum villain damage while my 12 HP absorbs the attack. I keep Get Ready for a future emergency thwart swing.
All plays exhausted for this turn — Ultron took 3 damage, setup Drone is dead, both allies chipped in, and I'm in hero form to control threat during the villain phase.
Hand of 3 is below the hero hand size of 5; keeping all three cards (Photonic Blast nuke, Get Ready utility, Emergency energy) and drawing 2 fresh cards.

Tank the hit: full 12 HP early is meant to be spent, defending with the hero would forfeit my basic attack next round (worse than the 1 HP saved by DEF 1), Hawkeye must not risk dying to a big boost (he's the drone engine), and Maria only has one action left in her body which is worth more on offense/thwart. Damage taken also activates Rechannel next round.

Spawn the Drone instead of adding threat — Hawkeye's response will immediately ping it for lethal damage (2 dmg vs 1 HP) with no attack against me, and the card cycles into my discard. Zero threat added.
Firing Hawkeye's response to instantly kill the 1-HP Drone — this is exactly the anti-Ultron engine I built the turn around. Threat stays at 1 and no minion gets to attack me.

Rechannel first while I'm damaged: spends the Emergency card (exact 1 energy, otherwise near-dead in hero form) to heal 9→10 and draw a card, giving me info before committing the rest of my resources.
Emergency is a perfect-exact 1 energy for Rechannel; saving the Energy card (2 icons) for Photonic Blast where all 2 icons get used.

Fire Photonic Blast now — 5 damage plus the energy-payment bonus draw. Racing Ultron down fast is my best plan: my HP clock is tighter than my threat clock, and Avengers Mansion's cost-4 would cost me this entire nuke plus my basic attack tempo for a slow-payback engine.

Pays exactly 3 with energy included (triggering the bonus draw), burns the weakest fuel (Power of Leadership's lone wild icon) and keeps Get Ready — a zero-cost utility play worth more than static fuel.

Paying with Get Ready (near-dead without healthy allies) and Mansion (would take 4 fuel icons I can't spare this round) — then my hand empties and I draw 5 fresh cards for a wide round 3.

Basic attack to bring Ultron to 7 HP — setting up the stage-1 kill next round. Hawkeye stays ready (acting would kill him via consequential damage at 1 HP, and he must live as the drone-ping engine), and threat at 1 needs no thwarting.
Turn complete: dealt 7 damage this round (Ultron at 7), Cosmic Flight armed to negate tonight's attack, Hawkeye preserved as a ready deterrent.

No defender — Cosmic Flight will interrupt and prevent 3 of the damage once the boost is revealed (likely negating the whole attack), while Hawkeye would certainly die defending and defending with the hero would cost my basic attack next round.
I'm about to take 4 damage — Cosmic Flight prevents exactly 3 of it (its maximum), turning a 4-damage hit into 1. Ideal timing for the card.

Spawn instead of threat: Hawkeye pings it dead for zero threat added, and this postpones the main scheme's stage-2 advance (with its +2-threat-or-drone hook) by a full round — threat sits at 2 of 3 and will trigger the advance naturally on round 3 anyway, so I spend a counter only to delay the pressure.
Standard Hawkeye ping to kill the 1-HP Drone instantly — zero threat, no attack against me.

The Power of Leadership is the right fuel: a lone wild icon with minimal use elsewhere, while Spider-Woman (ally + confuse) and Cosmic Flight (prevent 3 damage) are both high-value cards I want to keep or deploy properly.

Play Spider-Woman — she's my only ally left worth deploying: 2 ATK adds to the Ultron race, she's a 2-HP body for future defense/thwarting, and her confuse unlocks a future alter-ego turn where Ultron's scheme fizzles (free REC 4 heal).

Burns the pure-fuel Strength card (2 icons, no play value) plus Helmet (marginal +1 DEF) — keeps both Helicarrier (recurring cost reduction every phase) and Cosmic Flight (prevents 3 damage, my best defense vs Ultron's swings).

Basic attack for 2 more — Ultron drops to 3 HP and dies to a single activation next round.

Ping the When-Revealed Drone dead — standard play, no threat/no attack, counter 2→1.

choices.reasoning: Strong opening hand: Energy and Genius (4 resources combined) can pay exactly for Avengers Mansion, and Powered Gauntlets is a Tech upgrade that increases Iron Man's hand size. Tac Team and Repulsor Blast provide additional value/resources.
Use Futurist first for free card selection before committing resources - may find a better card or additional resources to enable more plays this turn.
Arc Reactor is a Tech upgrade (increases Iron Man's hand size) with a powerful ready ability that lets me attack/thwart an extra time each turn. Best long-term value of the three options.

Play Powered Gauntlets (cost 2) using Energy resource. This is a Tech upgrade that increases Iron Man's hand size and provides damage output. Setting up Tech upgrades early is critical for Iron Man's engine.
Energy is a pure resource card giving 2 energy - perfect for the cost-2 Powered Gauntlets. This preserves Genius (2 mental) and other cards for paying for Avengers Mansion (cost 4).

Avengers Mansion provides recurring card draw (1/turn) - the strongest long-term value engine available. Paying with Genius (2 mental) + Repulsor Blast (1 physical) + Tac Team (1 energy) = 4 resources exactly.
Paying with Repulsor Blast + Genius + Tac Team preserves Arc Reactor in hand - it's a Tech upgrade (increases Iron Man's hand size) with a powerful ready ability, worth keeping to play next turn.
Free card draw from Avengers Mansion - take it before changing form.

Changing to Iron Man hero form so the villain attacks instead of scheming during the villain phase. Klaw scheming would add 2+ threat to the main scheme, which matters since Defense Network's crisis icon prevents me from removing main scheme threat.

Defense Network's crisis icon prevents me from removing main scheme threat at all. Thwarting it now (3→1) unlocks main scheme thawarting next turn. Armored Guard's tough status means attacking it now would be wasted - better to remove tough later when I can follow up with real damage.
Use Powered Gauntlets to remove Armored Guard's tough status. The damage is prevented but tough is removed, setting up real damage next turn. Gauntlets readies at end of turn anyway so no loss.
Hand has 2 cards (Arc Reactor, Supersonic Punch) which equals my hand size of 2 (1 base + 1 Tech upgrade Powered Gauntlets). Nothing to discard.

Klaw's base ATK is 0 so all damage comes from boosts - defending with DEF 1 saves only 1 damage but exhausts Iron Man, preventing me from defending Armored Guard's attack next. Better to take Klaw's boost damage now and defend Armored Guard (ATK 1) with DEF 1 to reduce it to 0.
DEF 1 reduces Armored Guard's ATK 1 to 0 damage - free defense, no reason to take the damage.
Free card draw from Avengers Mansion - take it before making other decisions to see what options open up.

Play Arc Reactor - key Tech upgrade that increases hand size and provides ready ability. Paying with Supersonic Punch (event, one-time use) and Mockingbird (ally) preserves my strongest cards. Then I can use Gauntlets + ready + thwart Defense Network to remove the crisis icon.
Use Powered Gauntlets to deal 1 damage first, then ready with Arc Reactor to get another action.
Weapons Runner has only 2 HP - Gauntlets brings it to 1, then after readying with Arc Reactor my basic attack (1 damage) will kill it. Armored Guard has 3 HP and would survive both hits.
Ready Iron Man so I can use a basic attack to finish off Weapons Runner (1 HP remaining).

Defense Network has only 1 threat left and my THW of 2 clears it entirely, removing the crisis icon that permanently blocks main scheme thawarting. This is more valuable than 1 damage on Weapons Runner - the crisis lock is a hard constraint on managing the main scheme clock.

Staying as Iron Man - changing to Tony Stark would make the villain scheme (Klaw SCH 2 + Weapons Runner SCH 1 + boost), pushing main scheme from 1 toward threshold 6. Better to face attacks in hero form where I can defend.

Klaw's base ATK is 0 so damage comes only from boosts. Defending exhausts Iron Man, preventing me from defending subsequent minion attacks (Armored Guard ATK 1 + Weapons Runner ATK 1 = 2 guaranteed damage). Better to take potential boost damage and defend a minion attack to reduce it with DEF 1.
DEF 1 reduces Armored Guard's ATK 1 to 0 damage - free defense.
Free card draw from Avengers Mansion before committing resources.
Kill Weapons Runner first with Gauntlets (1 damage = exact kill) - removes a minion attack and reduces incoming damage. This is free (just exhausts Gauntlets).
Weapons Runner has exactly 1 HP - Gauntlets kills it cleanly, removing one attacker from the board.

Pay with Supersonic Punch + Combat Training to preserve Mark V Helmet - it's a Tech upgrade (costs only 1 to play) that increases Iron Man's hand size, which is his core engine.
Ready Iron Man to get a basic attack in - will remove Armored Guard#47's tough status, setting it up to be killed next turn.
